description: This PHP source file defines the Backup controller class for the OpenCart admin tool module. It handles actions related to database backup, restore, file upload, download, and history management within the admin interface.

classes.name: Backup
classes.description: Controller class for managing database backups, restores, file uploads/downloads, and history viewing in the OpenCart admin system.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the backup management page with list of tables and backup history.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Retrieves a list of backup files from the storage directory, including filename, size, creation date, and download link.

methods.name: backup
methods.description: Creates a new database backup task after verifying permissions and submitted table selections.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Queues a restore task for a specified backup file, given proper permissions.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Handles uploading of a .sql backup file, validating filename and type.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Prepares and outputs a backup file for download, verifying permissions and file existence.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified backup file, after permission and existence checks.
